name: Adire fabric scarf
where: Lekki Arts & Crafts Market or PR Fabrics, Lekki Phase 1
about: Adire is a traditional Yoruba resist-dyeing method, and Lagos is one of its best-known centers. Each scarf shows patterns made by tying, folding, or stitching the cloth before dyeing.
tip: Check that the colors do not run by rubbing a damp corner of the cloth on white paper.

name: Aso oke accessory
about: Aso oke is a narrow-strip woven cloth from the Yoruba people, often worn at celebrations. Lagos is a major place to see and buy it, and small pieces make easy gifts.
tip: Ask whether the cloth is hand-woven and locally made, since machine-made copies are common.
